original_description: Tighten talking-head videos with Yaps desktop by detecting speech, removing dead air and long pauses, and exporting a separate MP4 without touching the source. Review the exact keep ranges and estimated result before rendering, choose Tight, Natural, or Relaxed pacing, adjust safe boundary padding, redetect only when detection settings change, and verify the finished file. The plugin checks local Yaps reachability, Yaps 2.3.848 or newer, signed-in account access, Auto Cut readiness, and FFmpeg before processing the selected video. Requires a local-capable ChatGPT Desktop Work or Codex session; ChatGPT web and cloud sessions cannot reach the installed Yaps engine. Users can also run Auto Cut directly in Yaps.
summary_ja: 話す動画の無音や長い間を検出・削除し、元動画と別のMP4に書き出す。
limitations: Yaps 2.3.848以降、サインイン、FFmpegなどを確認し、ローカル対応のChatGPT Desktop WorkまたはCodexセッションが必要と説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
